The decisions playground page is now served at `/ml-inference/playground` instead of `/ml-inference/decisions`. I haven't run the app or any tests.

I changed the route and the `urls.decisionPlayground()` helper in two places:
- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`, the product manifest.
- `frontend/src/products.tsx`, the aggregated copy of the manifests, which I edited by hand to match.

Anything that links through `urls.decisionPlayground()` picks up the new path without further edits. A search of `products`, `frontend/src`, `posthog`, `docs`, `services`, `common` and `ee` found no other hardcoded references to the old page URL.

I left the backend API path (`ml_inference/decisions`) and the `ml-inference-decisions` feature flag alone, since only the page URL was in scope. I did not add a redirect, so bookmarks to the old URL will stop working.

`frontend/src/products.tsx` is generated, so regenerating it should produce the same output. I didn't confirm that.
